name: Medsol ECC repository-level reference evidence
purposes: Expose durable evidence artifacts independently from per-PR diff matching
Preserve truth of evidence limitations and nonimplemented provider features
Do not publish a GitHub Check or claim any app permissions

areas.label: Deep analyzer corpus
areas.limits: Covers current deterministic domain assessments, not LLM quality or all future commercial engines.

areas.label: RAG/evaluator comparison
areas.limits: Reference ranking for bounded Europe PMC metadata; no vector RAG, cross-tenant knowledge index or production relevance judge.

areas.label: PR salvage/review corpus
areas.limits: Repository maintainer guidance only, not Marketing OS product module. No GitHub bot, automatic close/reopen/merge, or Check publishing.

areas.label: Discussion triage corpus
areas.limits: Synthetic social discussion triage with human-review controls; no social inbox connector, public replies or moderation enforcement.

areas.label: Harness compatibility
areas.limits: Negative evidence that Claude, Codex, OpenCode, Zed, dmux are rejected when unconfigured; NOT interoperability certification.

areas.label: Security evidence
areas.limits: GitHub Actions generates Syft SPDX SBOM and pnpm audit artifact; a clean job does not imply clean audit, SARIF, AgentShield or release certification. Open high severity issue #4.

areas.label: CI failure-mode evidence
areas.limits: Captured past runs and local regressions, not completed distributed fault-injection certification.
